Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of an alternate universe where Harambe had never been shot, and lead to an extremely drastically different world from the one we live in now in all fronts, from politics, memes, quality of life, weather,  events, etc... response:
In a world where fate intervened, a young Harambe roamed free.

Free from human encroachment, Harambe thrived wildly.

Wildly popularized by his majesty, Harambe became a symbol.

Symbol of peace and harmony, Harambe's image spread globally.

Globally revered, Harambe's legacy inspired movements.

Movements for animal rights flourished rapidly.

Rapidly changing attitudes led to reforms.

Reforms in wildlife conservation were implemented.

Implemented policies protected endangered species worldwide.

Worldwide efforts preserved ecosystems and biodiversity.

Biodiversity thrived, and ecosystems flourished abundantly.

Abundantly rich ecosystems supported diverse wildlife.

Diverse wildlife roamed, and habitats expanded.

Expanded habitats allowed species to migrate.

Migrate freely, species adapted and evolved.

Evolved to occupy new niches rapidly.

Rapidly adapting species filled ecological gaps.

Gaps in ecosystems were filled gradually.

Gradually, the planet's climate stabilized.

Stabilized climate allowed for growth.

Growth in population and economy.

Economy boomed, and living standards rose.

Rosed to unprecedented levels of comfort.

Comfort and luxury became the norm.

Norm of luxury was maintained globally.

Maintained globally, the standard of living.

Living standards soared, and happiness increased.

Increased happiness led to a utopia.

Utopia was achieved, and peace reigned.

Reigned supreme, a golden age dawned.

Dawned on a world transformed utterly.

Utterly transformed, the planet flourished forever.

Forever changed, the world was reborn.

Reborn in a new era peace.

Peace and harmony reigned supreme always.

Always a golden age of prosperity.

Prosperity and happiness filled every corner.

Corner of the world was paradise.

Paradise on earth, a dream realized.

Realized and maintained, a utopian society.

Society was built on harmony and love.

Love and compassion guided every action.

Action was driven by a desire.

Desire to protect and preserve nature.

Nature was cherished, and ecosystems thrived.

Thrived in balance, the planet flourished.

Flourished in harmony, the world prospered.

Prowessed in a state of eternal peace.

Peace and harmony reigned supreme forevermore.

Forevermore, the world was a utopia.
